exact: maintenance of mitotic sister chromatin cohesion at telomere
maintenance of sister chromatin cohesion at telomere at mitosis
maintenance of telomeric mitotic sister chromatin cohesion

definition: The process in which the association between sister chromatids of a replicated chromosome along the length of the telomeric region is maintained as chromosomes condense, attach to the spindle in a bipolar orientation, and congress to the metaphase plate during a mitotic cell cycle.
label: maintenance of mitotic sister chromatid cohesion, telomeric
